async def act(page):
    """
    Scroll to the bottom of the currently-loaded homepage and navigate to page 2 of the blog feed.
    Uses accessibility-role based selectors and defensive checks before clicking.
    """
    # 1) Scroll to the bottom to reveal pagination controls
    await page.evaluate("window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)")
    # brief pause for lazy-loaded content to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(700)

    # 2) Try scoped search inside the main region for an exact numeric '2' link first
    main = page.get_by_role("main")
    try:
        if await main.count() > 0:
            # prefer an exact visible '2' link inside main
            try:
                loc_two = main.get_by_role("link", name="2", exact=True)
                if await loc_two.count() > 0:
                    await loc_two.first().click()
                    return
            except Exception:
                pass

            # try a few common visible pagination labels inside main
            candidate_names = [
                "Page 2",
                "Next",
                "Next ›",
                "›",
                "→",
                "»",
                "Older Posts",
                "Older",
                "Next Page",
                "Older Entries",
            ]
            for name in candidate_names:
                try:
                    loc = main.get_by_role("link", name=name)
                    if await loc.count() > 0:
                        await loc.first().click()
                        return
                except Exception:
                    continue
    except Exception:
        # If accessing main is flaky, continue to global strategies
        pass

    # 3) Global heuristics across all links: inspect href patterns and rel attribute
    links = page.get_by_role("link")
    total = await links.count()

    # Common href patterns that indicate page 2
    patterns = [
        "/page/2",
        "/page/2/",
        "paged=2",
        "?paged=2",
        "page=2",
        "?page=2",
        "/?page=2",
        "/?paged=2",
    ]

    for i in range(total):
        try:
            href = await links.nth(i).get_attribute("href") or ""
        except Exception:
            href = ""
        if any(p in href for p in patterns):
            await links.nth(i).click()
            return

    # 4) Look for rel="next"
    for i in range(total):
        try:
            rel = await links.nth(i).get_attribute("rel") or ""
        except Exception:
            rel = ""
        if rel and "next" in rel.strip().lower():
            await links.nth(i).click()
            return

    # 5) Try a global visible-name exact '2' and other common labels
    try:
        loc_two_global = page.get_by_role("link", name="2", exact=True)
        if await loc_two_global.count() > 0:
            await loc_two_global.first().click()
            return
    except Exception:
        pass

    candidate_names_global = [
        "Page 2",
        "Next",
        "Next ›",
        "›",
        "→",
        "»",
        "Older Posts",
        "Older",
        "Next Page",
        "Older Entries",
    ]
    for name in candidate_names_global:
        try:
            loc = page.get_by_role("link", name=name)
            if await loc.count() > 0:
                await loc.first().click()
                return
        except Exception:
            continue

    # 6) Final heuristic: scan text of each link to find an exact '2'
    for i in range(total):
        try:
            text = (await links.nth(i).inner_text()).strip()
        except Exception:
            text = ""
        if text == "2":
            await links.nth(i).click()
            return

    # If we reach here, no pagination link for page 2 was found
    raise Exception("Unable to find a pagination link for page 2 after scrolling to bottom.")
